note: Four identical InnoMaker U20CAM-1080P-S1 130-degree lens modules from the final purchase recommendation, installed as two wrists plus front and overhead. Native capture 640x480/30. Intrinsics are a nominal pinhole approximation from the manual technical table horizontal FOV=106 degrees; actual mode crop, distortion, focus and mount poses require calibration.

left_wrist.optics_note: Manufacturer manual v1.1: 130-degree diagonal; technical table 106-degree horizontal (feature list says 103). Nominal pinhole uses 106 horizontal at 640x480. Distortion coefficients are unmeasured zero placeholders; the advertised diagonal angle is not reproduced by this pinhole estimate.
